      # syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
      # Generated by rcapsule 0.2.0
      # Project: clinical-trial-app (shiny) | R 4.4.1
      FROM rocker/r-ver:4.4.1 AS builder
      ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
          TZ=UTC \
          LANG=C.UTF-8 \
          LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 \
          R_REPOS=https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2026-01-15
      # 1. OS system dependencies (build + runtime)
      RUN apt-get update \
          && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            ca-certificates \
            curl \
          && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
      WORKDIR /capsule
      # R package dependencies (cached independently of project code)
      RUN Rscript -e "install.packages(c('bslib', 'mirai', 'promises', 'shiny'), repos = Sys.getenv('R_REPOS'), Ncpus = parallel::detectCores())"
      # =============================================================================
      # Runtime stage: lean non-root execution image
      # =============================================================================
      FROM rocker/r-ver:4.4.1 AS runtime
      LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="clinical-trial-app" \
            org.opencontainers.image.revision="uncommitted" \
            org.rcapsule.version="0.2.0" \
            org.rcapsule.project_type="shiny" \
            org.rcapsule.r_version="4.4.1"
      ENV TZ=UTC \
          LANG=C.UTF-8 \
          LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
      # Runtime-only OS libraries
      RUN apt-get update \
          && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            ca-certificates \
            curl \
          && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
      # Copy compiled R libraries and toolchains from builder
      COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/R/site-library /usr/local/lib/R/site-library
      # Create dedicated non-root runtime user
      RUN groupadd --system capsule && useradd --system --gid capsule --create-home capsule && mkdir -p /capsule && chown -R capsule:capsule /capsule
      WORKDIR /capsule
      COPY --chown=capsule:capsule . /capsule/
      USER capsule
      EXPOSE 3838
      HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
          CMD curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3838/ || exit 1
      CMD ["Rscript", "-e", "shiny::runApp('/capsule', host = '0.0.0.0', port = 3838L)"]

      # Generated by rcapsule 0.2.0
      # Project: clinical-trial-app (shiny) | R 4.4.1
      Bootstrap: docker
      From: rocker/r-ver:4.4.1
      
      %labels
          Project clinical-trial-app
          ProjectType shiny
          RVersion 4.4.1
          GitRevision uncommitted
          CreatedBy rcapsule-0.2.0
      
      %files
          . /capsule
      
      %environment
          export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
          export LANG=C.UTF-8
          export TZ=UTC
          export CAPSULE_DIR=/capsule
      
      %post
          set -euo pipefail
          export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
          export TZ=UTC
          export R_REPOS=https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2026-01-15
      
          # OS system dependencies
          apt-get update \
          && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            ca-certificates \
            curl \
          && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
      
          cd /capsule
          # Install discovered R packages
          Rscript -e "install.packages(c('bslib', 'mirai', 'promises', 'shiny'), repos = Sys.getenv('R_REPOS'), Ncpus = parallel::detectCores())"
      
          # HPC compatibility: create standard bind mount points & non-root read permissions
          mkdir -p /scratch /work /data
          chmod -R a+rX /capsule
      
      %runscript
          cd /capsule
          exec Rscript -e "shiny::runApp('/capsule', host = '0.0.0.0', port = 3838L)" "$@"
      
      %test
          set -euo pipefail
          R --version
          Rscript -e "pkgs <- c('bslib', 'mirai', 'promises', 'shiny'); missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]; if (length(missing)) stop('Missing packages: ', paste(missing, collapse = ', '))"
